name: Angsana Laguna Phuket
short_description: A 5-star beachfront resort on Bang Tao Bay's lagoon parkland, about 20 minutes from Phuket International Airport.
ai_summary: Angsana Laguna Phuket sits within the Laguna Phuket beachfront estate on Bang Tao Bay, described on its own Accor listing as around 20 minutes from the airport. Rooms range up to a 2-bedroom Island suite, with balconies throughout. No aggregate ALL guest rating was shown on the hotel's page at the time of research.

faqs.question: Where is Angsana Laguna Phuket located?
faqs.answer: On Bang Tao Bay within the Laguna Phuket beachfront estate, about 20 minutes' drive from Phuket International Airport. The resort offers rooms up to a 2-bedroom Island suite, all with balconies, and sits within a lagoon-parkland setting shared with other Laguna Phuket properties along the same stretch of beach.
